presets.name: Bare
presets.summary: No background, none of the rare extras.
presets.description: The style stripped back: no background, so the drawing sits on whatever your page is, and the beard, gesture, glasses and shirt print all switched off.

presets.name: Sepia
presets.description: The style only has two colors, so a sepia treatment is the whole picture at once: warm brown for every line and filled mass, tanned paper for the body.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.description: The quietest set here. Nothing competes with the page around it, which suits an admin table or a comment thread where the avatar is a marker rather than a picture.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.summary: Deep teal on mint, two colors total.
presets.description: Notionists draws with exactly one dark and one light color, which makes it the one style where a duotone is not an approximation. These two are the entire palette.

presets.name: Inverted
presets.summary: White line on black, like chalk.
presets.description: Swaps the two colors. Most styles break when the linework goes pale, because their fills stay light and the outlines dissolve. Here the fill is a color group too, so it goes dark with the background and the drawing reads as chalk on a board.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.summary: Five soft backgrounds, the drawing untouched.
presets.description: Changes nothing about the people, only what they stand in front of. The lightest way to make a set of avatars feel like it belongs together.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.description: Black on a strong color is the most legible this style gets. Strong enough that the avatar holds its own against a busy page.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient behind, the drawing untouched.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. The seed still decides which of the two ends up on top, so the light comes from either side across a set.

presets.name: Full Cast
presets.summary: Beards, glasses, gestures and shirt prints turned up.
presets.description: Four components sit between 10 and 50 percent, so a small set of avatars rarely shows any of them. This raises all four, which is what you want when showing the style off rather than filling a user list.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.summary: Scaled in on the face, for small avatars.
presets.description: Uses scale rather than color. At the size a comment thread gives an avatar, the default framing spends most of it on shoulders, and cropping in buys the detail back.
